sources.title: Lyria 3 Pro Preview API specification
sources.evidence: The page title and section identify Pro Preview, and its Versions list includes lyria-3-pro-preview. It specifies 131072 input tokens, text/image inputs, audio MP3 and lyrics text outputs, and unsupported thinking/function calling. Its Model code row incorrectly says lyria-3-clip-preview; the page also says 48kHz, conflicting with the exact Cloud Pro documentation.

sources.title: Gemini API changelog: March 25, 2026
sources.evidence: March 25 explicitly launches lyria-3-pro-preview for full-length songs alongside the separate Clip preview. Both accept text and image prompts. This is the exact API release, rather than the earlier Lyria 3 consumer introduction.

sources.title: Lyria 3 Pro: Create longer tracks in more Google products
sources.evidence: Dated March 25, 2026. Introduces Lyria 3 Pro, announces public preview in Vertex AI and availability in Google AI Studio/Gemini API, and describes songs up to about three minutes with controls for intros, verses, choruses and bridges. The article distinguishes Pro from Lyria 3 introduced the previous month.

sources.title: Lyria 3 model card, updated March 2026
sources.evidence: Its stated scope covers Lyria 3 and subsequent versions. It explicitly discloses latent diffusion applied to temporal audio latents and outputs music plus lyrics. Distribution is through products and APIs subject to terms. No total or active parameter count is disclosed.

sources.title: Lyria 3.5 model card, July 2026
sources.evidence: Checked this later first-party card for a retrospective count or comparison naming Lyria 3 Pro. It contains no total/active parameter count for Pro. Its own architecture and scope are not substituted for the March Lyria 3 card.

sources.title: Google Cloud Lyria 3: exact Pro Preview section
sources.evidence: The 3 Pro Preview section explicitly identifies lyria-3-pro-preview and release March 25, 2026. It documents text/image prompting, audio output, vocals, instrumental mode, lyrics generation, supplied lyrics and song-structure controls. Its 184-second maximum and 44.1kHz specification differ from the rounded three-minute launch description and the Gemini page 48kHz claim. No text-token context limit or parameter count is stated here.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Gemini API is supplied under service terms; extraction or replication of underlying model weights is prohibited. Together with API distribution in the model card this supports proprietary, closed-weight classification. The documentation footer licenses do not license the model weights.

sources.title: Gemini API model lifecycle: Lyria
sources.evidence: The exact Pro preview row gives March 25, 2026, no announced shutdown date, and Lyria 3.5 as the recommended replacement. This does not prove live endpoint operation, which was not tested.

sources.title: Current music generation guide
sources.evidence: The current guide describes Lyria 3.5 and Lyria 3 Clip, not the old Pro preview. Its later full-song specifications are therefore not used to backfill Pro. The Pro API page remains the explicitly named source for its input-token limit and unsupported thinking/function-calling capabilities.

name.note: Exact Pro preview variant, distinct from Clip, RealTime and later Lyria 3.5.

developer.note: Google DeepMind develops the model; Google is the catalog developer grouping.

family.note: Named Lyria family; the release announcement identifies Pro as an advanced Lyria 3 version.

release_date.note: Exact Pro API/public-preview launch. Earlier February Lyria 3 consumer release and September Lyria 3.5 API GA are separate models/events.

open_weights.note: Distributed through hosted products/APIs under service terms, with no open checkpoint distribution documented.

license.note: Descriptive classification for closed Google service/model access. Documentation CC-BY and example-code Apache licenses do not apply to weights.

parameters_b.note: No total count in the exact API/Cloud specifications, March model card, launch or later Lyria 3.5 card. Bounded searches of first-party research and arXiv for Lyria 3/Pro technical reports and parameter counts yielded no exact-model disclosure; do not transfer counts from Magenta, MusicLM or Lyria RealTime.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active count was found in the inspected sources or later card. Diffusion steps, output duration and other music models do not establish a parameter count.

architecture.note: The March Lyria 3 card explicitly covers Lyria 3 and subsequent versions and discloses latent diffusion over temporal audio latents; the launch identifies Pro as that advanced version. No dense/MoE or Transformer subtype is asserted.

context_window.note: Documented input-token ceiling under the exact Pro page/section, whose Versions list includes Pro. The Model code row erroneously labels Clip, so this inconsistency is recorded. Not a combined text input/output budget, audio-duration limit or inference-tested claim.

modalities.note: Text/image prompts; generated audio plus lyrics text. Cloud supports generated and user-supplied lyrics. The general card lists text input only; exact API/Cloud sources explicitly add image input.

reasoning.note: Thinking is explicitly unsupported in the Pro-labelled API capability table; song composition does not imply an exposed thinking mode. The model-code copy error is documented.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly unsupported in the Pro-labelled API capability table. This describes source-reported API capability, not external tool orchestration around a music model.

description.value: Music generation model for songs and lyrics from text or image prompts, with vocals and controls for song structure.
description.note: Plain summary of documented Pro music generation and structure controls without performance claims.

patch.description: Music generation model for songs and lyrics from text or image prompts, with vocals and controls for song structure.

patch.notes: Total and active parameter counts are not disclosed. The Lyria 3 card describes latent diffusion and explicitly covers subsequent versions. The Pro API page documents 131,072 input tokens but mistakenly labels its model-code row as Clip; its title, section and version list identify Pro. Gemini and Cloud documentation disagree on audio sample rate, so no rate is asserted. Lyria 3.5 is the recommended replacement; no shutdown date is announced.

summary: Verified the exact March 25 Pro preview launch and all 14 factual fields. Added latent-diffusion architecture and proprietary license; replaced the vague description with documented capabilities. Counts remain undisclosed after exact-model sources, later card and research search. Retained documented input limit and negative capability flags with the Pro page model-code copy error recorded. Kept Pro separate from Clip, the earlier consumer Lyria 3, and later Lyria 3.5.
